note: Rains County (TX) has no published zoning district service. Texas counties have no general zoning authority, and the county has no zoning layer in ArcGIS Hub/Online. The cities checked publish zoning only as PDF/image maps or ordinance text: Emory's zoning map page (cityofemory.com/planning-zoning/zoning-map/) has no GIS link; Lone Oak's zoning map is a PDF; Point's site lists no zoning map or GIS service. No queryable polygon service of zoning districts was found for the county or its cities.
